mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_share (user_id, file_id, is_dir, share_token, access_password, status, expire_time, max_download, download_count, allow_download, allow_save) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileId}, #{isDir}, #{shareToken}, #{accessPassword}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{maxDownload}, #{downloadCount}, #{allowDownload}, #{allowSave})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_share WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_share SET status = #{status}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, download_count = #{downloadCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_share SET allow_download = #{allowDownload}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_share SET download_count = download_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW()) AND (max_download = 0 OR download_count < max_download)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_share WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 0 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW())
SELECT * FROM t_share ORDER BY created_at DESC
